messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: Triggered page for service=reserved-capacity (priority=P1) -> tenant=BrightWave. Symptoms: elevated p50/p99 latency on dedicated pool, increased 503s. Alert group: reserved-pool-qos. PD incident: RDW-76341.

raj_oncall: acked on call (Raj). I'm on it. Anyone seen this trend earlier? :eyes:

maria_sre: i'm looking at the ingress tails and the scaling metrics. p99 for BrightWave endpoints jumped ~350ms -> 2.4s over last 4m. KV cache eviction spikes at 03:12:20 UTC.

suzanne_se: FYI customer BrightWave reported degraded perf via support webhooks ~03:15. They see timeouts in their live workspace.

raj_oncall: grabbing logs from the dedicated cluster now. running: ```
rdwctl cluster logs --cluster reserved-brightwave --since 10m | tail -n 120
```

pagerduty-bot: Reminder: If not acknowledged within 5m escalation to manager oncall.

maria_sre: log snippet: ```
[2026-03-15T03:12:34Z] error: kvcache: eviction spike, mem_pressure=78%, reclaimed=0
[2026-03-15T03:12:37Z] warn: router: slow-path-hit route=brightwave-primary backend=gpud-04 latency=2300ms
[2026-03-15T03:12:38Z] error: inference: 503 upstream-overloaded model_variant=redwood-v2-q4f
```

derek_reliability: sounds like KV cache thrash + backend saturating. Could be a bad request pattern or a recent rollout. Any recent deploys to that cluster?

suzanne_se: no deploys from BrightWave in the last hour. Their integration team confirms steady traffic from feed.

raj_oncall: checking rollout history: ```rdwctl deployments --cluster reserved-brightwave --last 2h``` -> nothing new. But I see a spike in long-running prompt sessions from a single IP block. Could be a hot-keyed burst.

maria_sre: quick mitigation plan: 1) enable tenant route fallback to shared-burst pool 2) increase dedicated pool burst tokens temporarily 3) enable prefix-kvcache pin for BrightWave to reduce eviction. Which do we try first?

raj_oncall: we should fail traffic over to shared-burst to stop tail latency immediately. I'll run the reroute. Command: ```rdwctl routing reroute --tenant brightwave --to shared-burst --reason \"latency spike, auto-mitigate\"```

suzanne_se: customer will get reconnect, heads-up that sessions may re-establish. Doing now? :white_check_mark:

raj_oncall: executed reroute command. Routing change committed, rolling out to edge proxies. Watching metrics.

maria_sre: watching: incoming request rate drops on reserved-brightwave by ~92% and p99 latency falls to ~320ms on shared-burst. 503s on reserved cluster stop. Looks effective.

pagerduty-bot: PD note: PagerDuty incident RDW-76341 acknowledged by raj_oncall at 03:17 UTC. No escalation required.

derek_reliability: good. Now we need a durable fix: either increase reserved pool capacity or tune kv cache. Let's collect flamegraphs and cache stats. Raj, can you snapshot the KV cache state before we scale down?

raj_oncall: snapshotting: ```rdwctl cluster snapshot-kv --cluster reserved-brightwave --out /tmp/bw-kv-0315.snap``` -> done and uploaded to /artifacts/incidents/RDW-76341/.

maria_sre: found high churn: many unique keys created from long prompt ids. Suggest adding short-term prefix caching for the top 5 heavy clients and enabling LRU protections. I'll open a quick config PR to adjust cache window.

suzanne_se: re: customer comms — sent BrightWave a note that we routed traffic to shared pool to mitigate latency and we're investigating root cause. They're ok with that for now.

raj_oncall: temporary autoscale increase applied: bumped reserved-brightwave burst_capacity +30% for 20m while we analyze. Command: ```rdwctl cluster scale --cluster reserved-brightwave --burst +30 --duration 20m --ticket RDW-76341``` 

maria_sre: note: autoscale action hit quota error initially due to reserved quotas; had to approve via org-quotas. That delay may explain why p99 stayed high for a few minutes. We should document quota approval steps in runbook.

derek_reliability: agreed. I'll draft a short runbook update: expedited quota approval flow + 1-click reroute.

raj_oncall: monitoring for 10m. p95/p99 stable on shared-burst. No further 503s.

pagerduty-bot: PD: If incident is not resolved by 03:40 UTC auto-escalation to oncall-manager.

maria_sre: next steps: 1) draft root cause: unexpected hot-keyed request pattern causing kvcache churn 2) propose long-term fix: tuning eviction policy + hotspot detection to route heavy clients to a dedicated shard 3) follow-up postmortem and customer-facing RCA.

suzanne_se: I will coordinate customer RCA and timeline. Customer asked for ETA on restoring original routing; I'd prefer to wait until autoscale ends and we validate cache changes.

raj_oncall: handing off monitoring to maria_sre for the next 30m. If anything regresses ping me. I'm stepping off for another pager. :wave:

maria_sre: acked handoff. I'll keep a live view and update RDW-76341 with timeline.

derek_reliability: thanks team. Please add any relevant artifacts to the incident folder. I'll triage follow-up actions in the backlog and assign owners.

suzanne_se: closing loop with customer: sent status update and estimated RCA ETA 24h.

maria_sre: final status at 03:42 UTC: mitigated (traffic routed to shared-burst, autoscale +30% applied temporarily, kv snapshot captured). Will run deeper analysis and postmortem.

incident-bot: Incident RDW-76341 marked as \"mitigated\" by maria_sre at 03:42 UTC.

maria_sre: handing off final oncall to derek_reliability for backlog actions and postmortem.

derek_reliability: ack handoff. I'll own the postmortem and follow-ups.
